description: Rung-transition vectors for agent_action_capsule.history's anchoring-evidence rung (docs/ledger-grade.md §4). Each case's evidence justifies exactly the named rung and no higher.

cases.name: rung-standalone-no-evidence
cases.description: One capsule, no countersignatures, no inclusion proofs -> the floor rung.

cases.name: rung-countersigned-only
cases.description: A matching countersignature and no inclusion proof -> countersigned, not higher.

cases.name: rung-local-anchored-explicit-visibility
cases.description: Inclusion proof with visibility=local -> local-anchored, not counterparty-visible or higher.

cases.name: rung-counterparty-visible
cases.description: Inclusion proof with visibility=counterparty -> counterparty-visible, not publicly-anchored.

cases.name: rung-publicly-anchored
cases.description: Inclusion proof with visibility=public -> publicly-anchored, the ceiling rung.

cases.name: neg-inclusion-proof-no-visibility-does-not-default-to-public
cases.description: An inclusion proof with no visibility field is evidence of registration, not of PUBLIC registration -> local-anchored (the floor anchored tier), never publicly-anchored.

cases.name: rung-per-capsule-takes-the-higher-of-multiple-evidence-items
cases.description: One capsule with BOTH a countersignature and a local-visibility inclusion proof -> local-anchored (the higher of the two it actually earned), not stuck at countersigned.

cases.name: neg-overclaim-misdirected-evidence-does-not-inflate-bundle
cases.description: Two capsules, A and B. A publicly-anchored inclusion proof is tied to A's capsule_id only; B has no evidence at all. The bundle rung is the MINIMUM across capsules (standalone, from B) -- A's strong evidence must never inflate the whole bundle's claim. This is the never-grades-up guard case (mutant target: dropping the capsule_id match in the inclusion-proof loop, or taking max() instead of min() across capsules, both make this vector wrongly report publicly-anchored).
